out_sql: ["SELECT AVG(explainability_score) AS average_explainability_score \nFROM creative_ai \nWHERE region = 'Europe' OR region = 'North America';"]

       country AS country

FROM PORTS p

GROUP BY p.PortName;"]

 JOIN DonorsPrograms dp ON p.ProgramID = dp.ProgramID
